---- MODULE ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisaDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
HlpTypeOK == /\ accept \in [Node -> BOOLEAN]
             /\ sentMsg \in [Node -> [Node -> BOOLEAN]]
             /\ rcvMsg \in [Node -> [Node -> BOOLEAN]]
HlpNoObedInit == \A m \in Node : Obedient(m) => m \notin RcvInit
HlpNoObedSend == \A nn, dst \in Node : Obedient(nn) => ~sentMsg[nn][dst]
HlpNoObedRcv == \A ss, nn \in Node : (Obedient(ss) /\ Obedient(nn)) => ~rcvMsg[ss][nn]
HlpNoObedAccept == \A nn \in Node : Obedient(nn) => ~accept[nn]
HlpInv == HlpNoObedInit => (HlpNoObedSend /\ HlpNoObedRcv /\ HlpNoObedAccept)
HlpConj == HlpTypeOK /\ HlpInv
LEMMA HlpTypeOKInit == Init => HlpTypeOK
PROOF BY Zenon DEF Init, HlpTypeOK
LEMMA HlpTypeOK_RI == ASSUME NEW nA1 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ ReceiveInit(nA1) => HlpTypeOK'
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF HlpTypeOK, ReceiveInit, SendAllFrom
LEMMA HlpTypeOK_RM == ASSUME NEW nA2 \in Node, NEW sA2 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ ReceiveMsg(nA2, sA2) => HlpTypeOK'
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF HlpTypeOK, ReceiveMsg, HasAQuorumRcv, HasBQuorumRcv, SendAllFrom
LEMMA HlpTypeOK_RMC == ASSUME NEW nA3 \in Node, NEW sA3 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ ReceiveMsgC(nA3, sA3) => HlpTypeOK'
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF HlpTypeOK, ReceiveMsgC, HasAQuorumRcv, HasBQuorumRcv, SendAllFrom
LEMMA HlpTypeOK_RII == ASSUME NEW nA4 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ ReceiveInitI(nA4) => HlpTypeOK'
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF HlpTypeOK, ReceiveInitI
LEMMA HlpTypeOK_RMI == ASSUME NEW nA5 \in Node, NEW sA5 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ ReceiveMsgI(nA5, sA5) => HlpTypeOK'
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF HlpTypeOK, ReceiveMsgI, HasAQuorumRcv, HasBQuorumRcv
LEMMA HlpTypeOK_FSS == ASSUME NEW nA6 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ FaultySendS(nA6) => HlpTypeOK'
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF HlpTypeOK, FaultySendS, SendAllFrom
LEMMA HlpTypeOK_FSA == ASSUME NEW nA7 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ FaultyStateSA(nA7) => HlpTypeOK'
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF HlpTypeOK, FaultyStateSA, SetReceiveColumn
LEMMA HlpTypeOK_FAA == ASSUME NEW nA8 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ FaultySendA(nA8) => HlpTypeOK'
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF HlpTypeOK, FaultySendA
LEMMA HlpTypeOKStut == HlpTypeOK /\ UNCHANGED vars => HlpTypeOK'
PROOF BY Zenon DEF HlpTypeOK, vars
LEMMA HlpTypeOKPresAux == ASSUME HlpTypeOK, Next PROVE HlpTypeOK'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpTypeOK_RI, HlpTypeOK_RM, HlpTypeOK_RMC, HlpTypeOK_RII, HlpTypeOK_RMI, HlpTypeOK_FSS, HlpTypeOK_FSA, HlpTypeOK_FAA DEF Next, ReceiveInit, ReceiveMsg, ReceiveMsgC, ReceiveInitI, ReceiveMsgI, FaultySendS, FaultyStateSA, FaultySendA
LEMMA HlpInvInit == Init => HlpInv
PROOF BY Zenon DEF Init, HlpInv, HlpNoObedInit, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept
LEMMA HlpSNonObed == ASSUME NEW sB1 \in Node, NEW nB1 \in Node, HlpNoObedSend, sentMsg[sB1][nB1] PROVE ~Obedient(sB1)
PROOF BY Zenon DEF HlpNoObedSend, Obedient
LEMMA HlpANew == ASSUME NEW nB2 \in Node, NEW sB2 \in Node, Obedient(nB2), ~Obedient(sB2), HlpNoObedRcv, HlpTypeOK PROVE ~HasAQuorumRcv(nB2, [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sB2][nB2] = TRUE])
PROOF
<1>1. ASSUME HasAQuorumRcv(nB2, [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sB2][nB2] = TRUE]) PROVE FALSE
  <2>1. PICK aB1 \in QuorumA : \A srcB1 \in Node : InA(srcB1, aB1) => ([rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sB2][nB2] = TRUE])[srcB1][nB2]
    BY Zenon, <1>1 DEF HasAQuorumRcv
  <2>2. PICK mB1 \in Node : InA(mB1, aB1) /\ Obedient(mB1)
    BY Zenon, <2>1, QuorumAssumption DEF InA, Obedient, QuorumAssumption
  <2>3. mB1 # sB2
    BY Zenon, <2>2 DEF Obedient
  <2>4. ([rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sB2][nB2] = TRUE])[mB1][nB2] = rcvMsg[mB1][nB2]
    BY Zenon, <2>3 DEF HlpTypeOK
  <2>5. ([rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sB2][nB2] = TRUE])[mB1][nB2]
    BY Zenon, <2>1, <2>2 DEF InA
  <2>6. ~rcvMsg[mB1][nB2]
    BY Zenon, <2>2 DEF HlpNoObedRcv, Obedient
  <2>7. QED BY Zenon, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6
<1>2. QED BY PTL, <1>1
LEMMA HlpBNew == ASSUME NEW nB3 \in Node, NEW sB3 \in Node, Obedient(nB3), ~Obedient(sB3), HlpNoObedRcv, HlpTypeOK PROVE ~HasBQuorumRcv(nB3, [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sB3][nB3] = TRUE])
PROOF
<1>1. ASSUME HasBQuorumRcv(nB3, [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sB3][nB3] = TRUE]) PROVE FALSE
  <2>1. PICK bB1 \in QuorumB : \A srcB2 \in Node : InB(srcB2, bB1) => ([rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sB3][nB3] = TRUE])[srcB2][nB3]
    BY Zenon, <1>1 DEF HasBQuorumRcv
  <2>2. PICK aB2 \in QuorumA : \A nnB1 \in Node : InA(nnB1, aB2) => InB(nnB1, bB1) /\ Symmetric(nnB1)
    BY Zenon, <2>1, QuorumAssumption DEF QuorumAssumption, InA, InB, Symmetric
  <2>3. PICK mB2 \in Node : InA(mB2, aB2) /\ Obedient(mB2)
    BY Zenon, <2>2, QuorumAssumption DEF QuorumAssumption, InA, Obedient
  <2>4. InB(mB2, bB1)
    BY Zenon, <2>2, <2>3 DEF InA, InB
  <2>5. ([rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sB3][nB3] = TRUE])[mB2][nB3]
    BY Zenon, <2>1, <2>4 DEF InB
  <2>6. mB2 # sB3
    BY Zenon, <2>3 DEF Obedient
  <2>7. ([rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sB3][nB3] = TRUE])[mB2][nB3] = rcvMsg[mB2][nB3]
    BY Zenon, <2>6 DEF HlpTypeOK
  <2>8. ~rcvMsg[mB2][nB3]
    BY Zenon, <2>3 DEF HlpNoObedRcv, Obedient
  <2>9. QED BY Zenon, <2>5, <2>7, <2>8
<1>2. QED BY PTL, <1>1
LEMMA HlpSendRMNNe == ASSUME NEW nC1 \in Node, NEW sC1 \in Node, NEW nnC1 \in Node, NEW dstC1 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, ReceiveMsg(nC1, sC1), nnC1 # nC1, Obedient(nnC1) PROVE ~sentMsg'[nnC1][dstC1]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsg, SendAllFrom, HlpNoObedSend, HlpTypeOK
LEMMA HlpSendRMEqA == ASSUME NEW nC2 \in Node, NEW sC2 \in Node, NEW dstC2 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, ReceiveMsg(nC2, sC2), Obedient(nC2), ~HasAQuorumRcv(nC2, [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sC2][nC2] = TRUE]) PROVE ~sentMsg'[nC2][dstC2]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsg, SendAllFrom, HlpNoObedSend, HlpTypeOK
LEMMA HlpSendRM == ASSUME NEW nC3 \in Node, NEW sC3 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, ReceiveMsg(nC3, sC3) PROVE HlpNoObedSend'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpSendRMNNe, HlpSendRMEqA, HlpSNonObed, HlpANew DEF HlpNoObedSend, ReceiveMsg
LEMMA HlpRcvRMMin == ASSUME NEW nC4 \in Node, NEW sC4 \in Node, NEW ssC4 \in Node, NEW nnC4 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedRcv, ReceiveMsg(nC4, sC4), Obedient(ssC4), Obedient(nnC4), ssC4 # sC4 PROVE ~rcvMsg'[ssC4][nnC4]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsg, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpTypeOK
LEMMA HlpRcvRM == ASSUME NEW nC5 \in Node, NEW sC5 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, ReceiveMsg(nC5, sC5) PROVE HlpNoObedRcv'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpRcvRMMin, HlpSNonObed DEF HlpNoObedRcv, ReceiveMsg, Obedient
LEMMA HlpAcceptRMNNe == ASSUME NEW nC6 \in Node, NEW sC6 \in Node, NEW nnC6 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveMsg(nC6, sC6), nnC6 # nC6, Obedient(nnC6) PROVE ~accept'[nnC6]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsg, HlpNoObedAccept, HlpTypeOK, HasBQuorumRcv
LEMMA HlpAcceptRMEqA == ASSUME NEW nC7 \in Node, NEW sC7 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveMsg(nC7, sC7), Obedient(nC7), ~HasBQuorumRcv(nC7, [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sC7][nC7] = TRUE]) PROVE ~accept'[nC7]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsg, HlpNoObedAccept, HlpTypeOK
LEMMA HlpAcceptRM == ASSUME NEW nC8 \in Node, NEW sC8 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveMsg(nC8, sC8) PROVE HlpNoObedAccept'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpAcceptRMNNe, HlpAcceptRMEqA, HlpSNonObed, HlpBNew DEF HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveMsg, Obedient
LEMMA HlpInvRM == ASSUME NEW nC9 \in Node, NEW sC9 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ HlpInv /\ ReceiveMsg(nC9, sC9) => HlpInv'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpSendRM, HlpRcvRM, HlpAcceptRM DEF HlpInv, HlpNoObedInit, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept
LEMMA HlpSendRMCNNe == ASSUME NEW nD1 \in Node, NEW sD1 \in Node, NEW nnD1 \in Node, NEW dstD1 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, ReceiveMsgC(nD1, sD1), nnD1 # nD1, Obedient(nnD1) PROVE ~sentMsg'[nnD1][dstD1]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsgC, SendAllFrom, HlpNoObedSend, HlpTypeOK
LEMMA HlpSendRMCEqA == ASSUME NEW nD2 \in Node, NEW sD2 \in Node, NEW dstD2 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, ReceiveMsgC(nD2, sD2), Obedient(nD2), ~HasAQuorumRcv(nD2, [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sD2][nD2] = TRUE]) PROVE ~sentMsg'[nD2][dstD2]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsgC, SendAllFrom, HlpNoObedSend, HlpTypeOK
LEMMA HlpSendRMC == ASSUME NEW nD3 \in Node, NEW sD3 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, ReceiveMsgC(nD3, sD3) PROVE HlpNoObedSend'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpSendRMCNNe, HlpSendRMCEqA, HlpSNonObed, HlpANew DEF HlpNoObedSend, ReceiveMsgC
LEMMA HlpRcvRMCMin == ASSUME NEW nD4 \in Node, NEW sD4 \in Node, NEW ssD4 \in Node, NEW nnD4 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedRcv, ReceiveMsgC(nD4, sD4), Obedient(ssD4), Obedient(nnD4), ssD4 # sD4 PROVE ~rcvMsg'[ssD4][nnD4]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsgC, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpTypeOK
LEMMA HlpRcvRMC == ASSUME NEW nD5 \in Node, NEW sD5 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, ReceiveMsgC(nD5, sD5) PROVE HlpNoObedRcv'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpRcvRMCMin, HlpSNonObed DEF HlpNoObedRcv, ReceiveMsgC, Obedient
LEMMA HlpAcceptRMCNNe == ASSUME NEW nD6 \in Node, NEW sD6 \in Node, NEW nnD6 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveMsgC(nD6, sD6), nnD6 # nD6, Obedient(nnD6) PROVE ~accept'[nnD6]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsgC, HlpNoObedAccept, HlpTypeOK, HasBQuorumRcv
LEMMA HlpAcceptRMCEqA == ASSUME NEW nD7 \in Node, NEW sD7 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveMsgC(nD7, sD7), Obedient(nD7), ~HasBQuorumRcv(nD7, [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sD7][nD7] = TRUE]) PROVE ~accept'[nD7]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsgC, HlpNoObedAccept, HlpTypeOK
LEMMA HlpAcceptRMC == ASSUME NEW nD8 \in Node, NEW sD8 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveMsgC(nD8, sD8) PROVE HlpNoObedAccept'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpAcceptRMCNNe, HlpAcceptRMCEqA, HlpSNonObed, HlpBNew DEF HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveMsgC, Obedient
LEMMA HlpInvRMC == ASSUME NEW nD9 \in Node, NEW sD9 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ HlpInv /\ ReceiveMsgC(nD9, sD9) => HlpInv'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpSendRMC, HlpRcvRMC, HlpAcceptRMC DEF HlpInv, HlpNoObedInit, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept
LEMMA HlpSendRMINNe == ASSUME NEW nE1 \in Node, NEW sE1 \in Node, NEW nnE1 \in Node, NEW dstE1 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, ReceiveMsgI(nE1, sE1), nnE1 # nE1, Obedient(nnE1) PROVE ~sentMsg'[nnE1][dstE1]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsgI, HlpNoObedSend, HlpTypeOK
LEMMA HlpSendRMIEqA == ASSUME NEW nE2 \in Node, NEW sE2 \in Node, NEW dstE2 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, ReceiveMsgI(nE2, sE2), Obedient(nE2), ~HasAQuorumRcv(nE2, [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sE2][nE2] = TRUE]) PROVE ~sentMsg'[nE2][dstE2]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsgI, HlpNoObedSend, HlpTypeOK
LEMMA HlpSendRMI == ASSUME NEW nE3 \in Node, NEW sE3 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, ReceiveMsgI(nE3, sE3) PROVE HlpNoObedSend'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpSendRMINNe, HlpSendRMIEqA, HlpSNonObed, HlpANew DEF HlpNoObedSend, ReceiveMsgI
LEMMA HlpRcvRMIMin == ASSUME NEW nE4 \in Node, NEW sE4 \in Node, NEW ssE4 \in Node, NEW nnE4 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedRcv, ReceiveMsgI(nE4, sE4), Obedient(ssE4), Obedient(nnE4), ssE4 # sE4 PROVE ~rcvMsg'[ssE4][nnE4]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsgI, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpTypeOK
LEMMA HlpRcvRMI == ASSUME NEW nE5 \in Node, NEW sE5 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, ReceiveMsgI(nE5, sE5) PROVE HlpNoObedRcv'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpRcvRMIMin, HlpSNonObed DEF HlpNoObedRcv, ReceiveMsgI, Obedient
LEMMA HlpAcceptRMINNe == ASSUME NEW nE6 \in Node, NEW sE6 \in Node, NEW nnE6 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveMsgI(nE6, sE6), nnE6 # nE6, Obedient(nnE6) PROVE ~accept'[nnE6]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsgI, HlpNoObedAccept, HlpTypeOK, HasBQuorumRcv
LEMMA HlpAcceptRMIEqA == ASSUME NEW nE7 \in Node, NEW sE7 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveMsgI(nE7, sE7), Obedient(nE7), ~HasBQuorumRcv(nE7, [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![sE7][nE7] = TRUE]) PROVE ~accept'[nE7]
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF ReceiveMsgI, HlpNoObedAccept, HlpTypeOK
LEMMA HlpAcceptRMI == ASSUME NEW nE8 \in Node, NEW sE8 \in Node, HlpTypeOK, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveMsgI(nE8, sE8) PROVE HlpNoObedAccept'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpAcceptRMINNe, HlpAcceptRMIEqA, HlpSNonObed, HlpBNew DEF HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveMsgI, Obedient
LEMMA HlpInvRMI == ASSUME NEW nE9 \in Node, NEW sE9 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ HlpInv /\ ReceiveMsgI(nE9, sE9) => HlpInv'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpSendRMI, HlpRcvRMI, HlpAcceptRMI DEF HlpInv, HlpNoObedInit, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept
LEMMA HlpInvRI == ASSUME NEW nF1 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ HlpInv /\ ReceiveInit(nF1) => HlpInv'
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF HlpTypeOK, HlpInv, HlpNoObedInit, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveInit, SendAllFrom, Obedient
LEMMA HlpInvRII == ASSUME NEW nF2 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ HlpInv /\ ReceiveInitI(nF2) => HlpInv'
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF HlpTypeOK, HlpInv, HlpNoObedInit, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept, ReceiveInitI, Obedient
LEMMA HlpInvFSS == ASSUME NEW nF3 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ HlpInv /\ FaultySendS(nF3) => HlpInv'
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF HlpTypeOK, HlpInv, HlpNoObedInit, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept, FaultySendS, SendAllFrom, Obedient
LEMMA HlpInvFSA == ASSUME NEW nF4 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ HlpInv /\ FaultyStateSA(nF4) => HlpInv'
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF HlpTypeOK, HlpInv, HlpNoObedInit, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept, FaultyStateSA, SetReceiveColumn, Obedient
LEMMA HlpInvFAA == ASSUME NEW nF5 \in Node PROVE HlpTypeOK /\ HlpInv /\ FaultySendA(nF5) => HlpInv'
PROOF BY SMTT("r10") DEF HlpTypeOK, HlpInv, HlpNoObedInit, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept, FaultySendA, Obedient
LEMMA HlpInvPresAux == ASSUME HlpTypeOK, HlpInv, Next PROVE HlpInv'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpInvRI, HlpInvRM, HlpInvRMC, HlpInvRMI, HlpInvRII, HlpInvFSS, HlpInvFSA, HlpInvFAA DEF Next, ReceiveInit, ReceiveMsg, ReceiveMsgC, ReceiveInitI, ReceiveMsgI, FaultySendS, FaultyStateSA, FaultySendA
LEMMA HlpInvStut == HlpInv /\ UNCHANGED vars => HlpInv'
PROOF BY Zenon DEF HlpInv, HlpNoObedInit, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept, vars
LEMMA HlpConjInit == Init => HlpConj
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpTypeOKInit, HlpInvInit DEF HlpConj
LEMMA HlpConjPresAux == ASSUME HlpConj, Next PROVE HlpConj'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpTypeOKPresAux, HlpInvPresAux DEF HlpConj
LEMMA HlpConjStut == HlpConj /\ UNCHANGED vars => HlpConj'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpTypeOKStut, HlpInvStut DEF HlpConj, vars
LEMMA HlpConjPres == HlpConj /\ [Next]_vars => HlpConj'
PROOF BY Zenon, HlpConjPresAux, HlpConjStut
LEMMA HlpConjBox == SafetySpec => []HlpConj
PROOF
<1>1. Init => HlpConj
  BY Zenon, HlpConjInit DEF Init
<1>2. HlpConj /\ [Next]_vars => HlpConj'
  BY Zenon, HlpConjPres DEF HlpConj
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, PTL DEF SafetySpec, HlpConj
LEMMA HlpConjImpliesInv == HlpConj => HlpInv
PROOF BY Zenon DEF HlpConj, HlpInv
LEMMA HlpBoxConjImp == [](HlpConj => HlpInv)
PROOF BY HlpConjImpliesInv, PTL DEF HlpConj, HlpInv
LEMMA HlpBoxInv == SafetySpec => []HlpInv
PROOF BY HlpConjBox, HlpBoxConjImp, PTL DEF SafetySpec, HlpConj, HlpInv
LEMMA HlpInvImpliesUnforge == HlpInv => Unforgeability
PROOF BY Zenon DEF HlpInv, Unforgeability, HlpNoObedInit, HlpNoObedSend, HlpNoObedRcv, HlpNoObedAccept, Obedient
LEMMA HlpBoxImp == [](HlpInv => Unforgeability)
PROOF BY HlpInvImpliesUnforge, PTL DEF HlpInv, Unforgeability
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Safety == SafetySpec => []Unforgeability
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa/ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa_Safety.tla
PROOF BY HlpBoxInv, HlpBoxImp, PTL DEF SafetySpec, HlpInv, Unforgeability
\* END AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa/ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa_Safety.tla

THEOREM CorrectnessLiveness == Spec => Correctness
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa/ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa_CorrectnessLiveness.tla
PROOF OMITTED
\* END AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa/ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa_CorrectnessLiveness.tla

THEOREM RelayLiveness == Spec => Relay
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa/ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa_RelayLiveness.tla
PROOF OMITTED
\* END AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa/ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa_RelayLiveness.tla
====
